Individual fund budget schedules are used for Depreciation, Nutrition, Bond, Special Building, QCPU, Student Fee and Activities funds; the nonmajor combining schedule (pp8-9) is not duplicated. Budget columns are totals only, so budget_final is null on lines except Student Fee. Student Fee Fund printed no actual disbursements (blank), so no line.
